skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the financial system, various types of risks, and consequences of these risks.
Analyze the interplay between different types of risks.
Identify major risks faced by enterprises and financial institutions.
Understand legal regulations related to risk management.
Select appropriate tools for mitigating and limiting specific types of risks.
Develop models and strategies for managing risks.
Practice teamwork skills through group assignments, writing reports, and presenting research results.
Analyze market risks including Value at Risk (VaR) and Expected Loss.
Manage credit risks including measurement and mitigation strategies.
Manage liquidity risks including measurement and mitigation strategies.
Manage operational risks including measurement and mitigation strategies.
Manage interest rate risks including forecasting and measurement techniques.
Manage currency risks including measurement and mitigation strategies.
